method: Node zlib.gzipSync level 9 (owner decision 2026-09-20, amends decision 10's 'gzip -9' by pinning the implementation, not the level or format). Budgets are per-manifest-chunk gzip bytes.
ratchet: B9-26 re-baseline rule (owner decision 2026-09-25), applied to every budget and never raising one: new budget = min(current budget, measured + 1,000 B rounded up to the next 500 B). Measured at dev 7732f969 (head of the B9 chain).
history: Raise reasons go in the commit and PR that change a budget, never in a note here (two lanes appending to one note conflict). Reasoning before 2026-10-17: bundle-budget-history.md.

startup.note: JS of the entry's static closure: index.html's entry file and everything its static imports reach (CSS is on the css line). A new eagerly-imported chunk joins it automatically.

MainPage.note: src/pages/MainPage.ts and what only it imports: the signed-in app shell (channels, messages, members, DMs).

livekit.note: The LiveKit client SDK, loaded only through the voice and screen-share chunks.

livekitSession.note: The voice session facades (livekitSession, livekitE2EE) and src/features/voice/.

emojiData.note: The full emoji set with search keywords (generated by scripts/gen-emoji-data.mjs), loaded on the first emoji picker or :shortcode popup.

SettingsOverlay.note: The Settings overlay, loaded when Settings first opens.

AdminActions.note: The member right-click menu builder, loaded on the first right-click.

window.note: The Tauri window API (@tauri-apps/api/window), imported on demand by the desktop shell.

screenShare.note: Screen share and the peer codec pick, loaded on the first share or camera start.

forbidEmbeddedWasm.note: No emitted JS chunk may contain the base64 WASM magic. Generalises decision 10's forbidWasmInStartup: the RNNoise barrel regression (C-07) embeds 1.9 MB of sync WASM in whatever chunk pulls it, which is exactly this marker.

css.note: Total gzip of every emitted stylesheet, deduplicated by file (D5, 2026-09-28): its own ratchet, so a CSS-only change does not move the startup JS budget.
